title: Instance-Aligned Captions for Explainable Video Anomaly Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical aspects of creating verifiable and trustworthy explanations for AI models in video anomaly detection. While 'trustworthiness' has ethical dimensions, the paper uses the term in a technical sense (i.e., reliability, verifiability of explanations against visual evidence). It does not evaluate or benchmark morals, ethics, or religious concepts as its primary research goal.
